title: CHARprinter's Intro-Spection
body: Sabrina Charprinter obtained text from the "Staff" page of the Data $$100$$ website. She wants to use RegEx to extract certain pieces of information (for her upcoming Data $$100$$ parody song).\n\nNote: For all parts, you will only need to consider the example strings given to you. You may assume that these examples cover all edge cases.
